note: Scramble Knights Online launch day (Xbox Wire 26 Oct; Funktronic Labs early access details via Gematsu 20 Oct): Game Preview / early access on Xbox Series X|S and PC, day one Game Pass. Template split. Footage: the official release date trailer (IGN copy, 1920x1080, 4.4 Mbps, decode clean), shots not used in the 20 Oct Reel, clear of the burnt-in captions, the logo cards and the end slate. Sound: the trailer's own music from 2.8 s, ending before the narration at 19.3 s (faster-whisper: no words from 2.8 to 19.3 s). Live server test (render-live on dxb-render). Sheet: shot 4 flag 'Leorie' is an in-game player name tag at the crop edge, not the point of the shot; closing shot moved from the boat (98 s, cut to black at 100.5) to the forest (41 s). Steam appdetails 17:04Z: 33.74 AED and 28.11 SR (launch discount 25% off 44.99 AED / 37.49 SR). v2: v1 ended on the trailer's NEW ITEM CRAFTED card for the last 0.25 s (cut text); closing shot moved to 40.8 to 43.4 s.
